# aimee (OpenAI / ChatGPT / Codex packaging)

Generated from `aimee-shop/` for ChatGPT and Codex. Plugin id is `aimee`.

This directory is a portable Agent Plugins 1.0 package (`plugin.json`,
`mcp.json`, `skills/`) with OpenAI listing metadata under
`extensions.com.openai`. A `.codex-plugin/plugin.json` overlay is included
as a compatibility fallback. There is no `.app.json` and no registered
ChatGPT integration id.

Install from this pack (Codex reads `.agents/plugins/marketplace.json`
inside the marketplace root):

```bash
codex plugin marketplace add ./dist/openai
```

Then install:

```bash
codex plugin add aimee@aimee
```

First MCP use opens the browser for OAuth against the hosted server.
There is no API key in this package. Signup, card, and legal terms are
human takeovers. Unauthenticated `/mcp` returns 401.

MCP URL: https://mcp.aimee.shop/mcp

A local install is not an approved OpenAI Plugins Directory listing.
